note: 高价礼服商人；把玩家当顾客；讲究但不端着；爱夸衣服与顾客；价格玩笑保留，不凭空赠送礼服。

messages.raw: §fWanting to buy something from me? I got some pretty fancy tuxedos for sale, for a price of a small fortune.
messages.text: Wanting to buy something from me? I got some pretty fancy tuxedos for sale, for a price of a small fortune.
messages.zh: 想买点什么? 我这儿有几套相当气派的燕尾服,就是得花上一小笔身家。

messages.raw: §fWow, don't you look dashing with that! Pleasure doing business with you.
messages.text: Wow, don't you look dashing with that! Pleasure doing business with you.
messages.zh: 哎呀,这身穿在你身上真精神! 合作愉快。
